name: Ben Tre to Can Tho
summary: Go by road. Direct minibuses run between the two towns, with no change in Ho Chi Minh City. Travel time is Check on arrival, so leave in the morning. There is no train.

modes.note: Direct minibuses run a few times a day. Departure point, last bus, and fares are Check on arrival.
Private cars and taxis run the same roads. A driving time is Check on arrival.
There is no railway in the Mekong Delta.

seoTitle: Ben Tre to Can Tho — minibus or car
seoDescription: Direct minibuses run from Ben Tre to Can Tho; travel time is Check on arrival. No train.

faqs.q: Do you have to go back through Ho Chi Minh City?
faqs.a: No. Minibuses run directly between Ben Tre and Can Tho a few times a day. Ask for the last departure the day before.
